prior.summary: New to this reviewed candidate catalogue and mechanism contrast; MC2023 prediction is prior, not first discovery.
prior.case_context: Experimental Nb3Pt and A15 alloys are known. The exact two-species ordered Nb6PdPt Pm-3 source is not established by binary Nb3Pt or random B-site alloy evidence. The 2026-10-07 exact Nb6PdPt query found no matching experimental superconducting ordered phase; novelty is bounded to this matched ordered-site hypothesis.

prior.claim_boundary: Every listed state already has a published source prediction. Related compositions or phases are not experimental confirmation of this exact state. This dossier does not establish global novelty or an exhaustive literature search.

bottleneck.summary: Target Gamma optical compression is positive and sampled path nonnegative. Antisite disorder, A15-chain softening/CDW and Pt SOC are the leading physical competitors; fine Fmax is 0.018999 eV/A. The PtAu control has much higher lambda but an actual negative source path and is retained, rather than silently treated as a stable superior candidate. Changed ecutwfc/PP/code between Ta and Pd remain explicit numerical-model confounds.
bottleneck.ambient_scope: Both source SCFs converge, near-zero coarse forces/stress and bounded fine response are measured. Fine Fmax=0.018998654 eV/A, P=0.032 GPa, full max stress=0.032 GPa. Gamma optical compression is positive beyond printing bound and sampled path has no signed negative values. All listed q outputs have JOBDONE/last response convergence and no routine errors. This supports a finite-grid local/metastable source model, not global hull or experimental synthesis.

counterevidence.scope: This frozen alternative has both higher coupling and higher source-model Tc than the target; the selected-control advantage does not extend to every alternative.

proposed_contribution.intervention: Pd replaces Ta on the unique non-Pt cation site while all six Nb and the Pt site retain mapped roles. Volume contracts 2.8275%, Nb-chain nearest distance falls 0.0253916 A and Nb-Pd versus Nb-Ta falls 0.0273996 A. All ten lambda values rise 31.713–43.016%, with separate Eli mu=.1 12.195 to 15.273 K; measured coupled chemistry/chain construction is not pure strain causality.
proposed_contribution.next_action: Hold ordered Pd/Ta and Pt roles fixed while matching cutoff/PP, volume and sampling, and compare an antisite or chain distortion competitor. A persistent stable direct coupling gain supports the screen; loss under common numerical controls or a nontranslation soft branch opposes it.
proposed_contribution.falsifier: Reproduce the stated target and control with matched pseudopotential family, functional, cutoff, sampling and relevant spin/SOC treatment. Loss or reversal of the claimed response, instability of the target, or an unresolved competing phase changes the decision; ambiguous outcomes remain unresolved.
proposed_contribution.new_state_inheritance: A child structure or modification needs its own calculation and identity. It does not inherit source Tc or experimental status.
